title: Filipino Keto Toasted Bread
description: A keto twist on a classic Filipino dish, using toasted bread and aromatic ingredients.

ingredients.name: Filipino
ingredients.notes: Low-carb version of traditional Filipino omelette mix

instructions: Toast the bread slices for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the Filipino-style omelette mix, grated ginger, and coconut cream.
Cook the mixture in a pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes.
Place the toasted bread on a baking sheet and top with the cooked mixture.
Bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the bread is crispy.
Remove from oven and serve hot.
